name: webgpu-compute-exploration
description: 25 interactive WebGPU compute shader examples in WGSL: simulations (SPH, cloth, N-body Barnes-Hut, waves, reaction-diffusion), parallel algorithms (sorting, k-means, Voronoi, BFS), rendering (path tracing, ray marching), signal processing (FFT, convolution reverb), and a CNN trained in the browser
author: Scott Friedman
